## Scope and acceptance

This record supplements the DCO certification for exactly the 15 commits listed
above. Their original commit messages have no `Signed-off-by` line. This record
does not modify those messages or commit hashes, and does not claim that the
original commits were signed off when created.

This record is submitted for explicit maintainer acceptance of the listed
historical contributions, with that decision retained in the pull request
review. It does not establish a general exception to the repository's requirement
to sign off each new commit. Passing the DCO check for the new commit does not,
by itself, establish acceptance of this historical record.
